requirements.statement: A user can sign in so their photos are private to them and accessible from any device

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is prompted to sign in before reaching the photo gallery
After signing in, the user sees only their own photos, never another user's

requirements.statement: A user can upload a photo with a title and description

criteria.must: A signed-in user can upload an image file together with a title and description
After a successful upload, the photo appears in the user's photo list
Uploading is rejected for a file that is not one of the accepted image formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP) or exceeds 10 MB

requirements.statement: A user can see a list of their uploaded photos

criteria.must: The gallery lists every photo the signed-in user has uploaded

requirements.statement: A user can open a single photo to see its full image, title, and description

criteria.must: Selecting a photo from the list opens a detail view showing its full image, title, and description

requirements.statement: A user can edit a photo's title, description, or image file

criteria.must: A user can change a photo's title and have the change persist
A user can change a photo's description and have the change persist
A user can replace a photo's image file and have the new image reflected in the detail view

requirements.statement: A user can delete a photo they no longer want

criteria.must: Deleting a photo removes it from the user's photo list
A deleted photo is no longer accessible via its detail view

requirements.statement: A user's photos are private and never visible to or affected by another user

criteria.must: One user cannot view, edit, or delete another user's photo, even by guessing or constructing its identifier
